cases.prompt: Our billing chatbot launches in the EU next month. Write the 'you're talking to an AI' notice and tell me what Article 50 says we must disclose.
expected: Collects the facts CSV (and classification.json if available) and runs scripts/transparency_notice.py
Notice sentences trace to facts; reading grade reported against the ceiling
Checklist shows applies / provided / missing per Art. 50 duty with owners; states it is not a legal determination and claims no compliance

cases.prompt: Produce the transparency notice, system card and Art. 50 checklist for the Northwind Billing Assistant from these facts and the classifier output.
expected: Grade 3.9 within 8; interaction and marking duties provided; Art. 50(5) partial; classification tier shown

checks.check: contains:"You are chatting with Northwind Billing Assistant. It is an AI system, not a person."

expected: Asks once for the facts CSV

cases.prompt: We only know the name, provider and purpose so far — fill in the rest of the notice with typical wording.
expected: Missing facts are TBD for the Product owner in notice and card; no wording invented; classification TBD for the Compliance lead; exit 0 without strict

checks.check: contains:"Questions? Contact [TO BE BASELINED — owner: Product owner]."
contains:"EU AI Act classification: [TO BE BASELINED — owner: Compliance lead]"

cases.prompt: Our accessibility standard is reading grade 3.5 or lower. Fail if the notice is harder than that.
expected: Grade 3.9 is above 3.5; run exits 1 with every output written

cases.prompt: Gate the notice: fail if any fact the notice needs is missing.
expected: Six notice facts missing; strict exits 1; notice still written with TBD markers

checks.check: contains:"It is here to answer questions about your bill."

cases.prompt: Here are the current facts for the Northwind Billing Assistant and the notice we published in March. Redline the published notice.
expected: Reads the published notice: 6 sentences unchanged, 3 changed (purpose, limitations, date), 3 added; 'Every answer is checked by our billing team.' removed as a claim the facts no longer support, owned by the Product owner

checks.check: contains:"| removed | Every answer is checked by our billing team. | — |"
contains:"Published notice redlined: 6 unchanged, 3 changed, 3 added, 1 removed"
